_comment: Machine-readable public-site content structure. Mirrors the existing, working homepage_content/homepage_sections/homepage_metrics/testimonials/homepage_faqs mechanism in blueprint/02-public-website-blueprint.md, PLUS the sections that are currently hardcoded in Sanad's own template (marked hardcoded_needs_template_rewrite below) and would need to be written directly into the new company's templates rather than configured through this file alone.

section_order_and_visibility._comment: Mirrors homepage_sections — set order/visible per section.

homepage_hardcoded_sections_needing_temp._comment: These are NOT configurable through the existing CMS mechanism in the current codebase — they are hardcoded in home.ejs and require a direct template rewrite per company, not just data entry here.

static_pages_needing_template_rewrite._comment: No admin-editable static-page CMS exists today — about/faq/guides are hand-coded templates. Building a general static-page CMS is new engineering (see GAP-REGISTER.md); until then, populate this as content the developer writes directly into new templates.

seo._comment: No SEO infrastructure exists in the current codebase — no sitemap, robots.txt, per-page meta description, OG tags, or structured data. This is greenfield new engineering, not configuration. See GAP-REGISTER.md.
